items.difficulty_reason: 19 行陈述含图（17 行证明）、Gysin 与 proper pushforward 交换（截口平凡化情形）：先 remark 合法化，积分闭归约，非含分支两个除子计算由 c1 等式引理收，含分支两侧零。5 处引用全具名（statement 2 + proof 2 + section），无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-closed-in-X-gysin (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2567-2585

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The operations are defined on cycles by the cited Gysin-on-cycles remark; reduce to the case of an integral closed subscheme W' and its image W; if W' is not contained in D' then W is not contained in D and both intersections are divisor computations whose equality under proper pushforward follows from the cited equal-c1 lemma; if W' is contained in D' then W is contained in D and both sides vanish by construction (source lines 2587-2603)
